message.incursion.core.stage.1: Stage I (Scout + Elder Guardian): The Elder Guardian hangs in its golden cage of rings above the plain, a beige beam leads from its eye into the antenna of the lid.
message.incursion.core.stage.2: Stage II (Breaker + Warden): The Warden stands in its cage of rings between two pillars, blue rings of sound run into the antenna. The Elder Guardian stays as a trophy on chains between the pillars.
message.incursion.core.stage.3: Stage III (Soul Weaver + Ender Dragon): The Ender Dragon hangs in its cage of rings, a violet beam leads into the antenna. Warden and Elder Guardian stay as trophies on golden chains between the pillars.
message.incursion.core.stage.4: Stage IV (Wither): The Wither hangs in its cage of rings, a white beam leads into the antenna, from which a beam of light rises into the sky. The other bosses feed the antenna as trophies.

message.incursion.general.tablet_set: The %1$s sinks into the Core. It begins to seethe … When the sun goes down, someone will come to take back what is his.
message.incursion.general.pending_night: The upgrade to level %2$s waits. The Core seethes … When the sun goes down, someone will come.
message.incursion.general.pending_presen: The upgrade to level %2$s waits: %1$s is here. Defeat him!
message.incursion.general.pending_insign: The upgrade to level %2$s waits: have a Master Toolsmith forge the %1$s into your tool, then right-click the Core with the %3$s.
message.incursion.general.arrived: %1$s has appeared (at %2$s %3$s %4$s) and attacks the Core!
message.incursion.general.vanished: %s fades away at dawn. He returns in the next night.
message.incursion.general.fallen: %1$s has fallen! The %2$s lies at %3$s %4$s %5$s: mine it and set it into the Core.
message.incursion.general.insignia_set: The %1$s is set in. The Core awakens to level %2$s.

message.incursion.general.wrong_insignia: Wrong insignia. The Core needs the %s.

message.incursion.general.no_spot: No free spot for the general found. Try again in a moment.
message.incursion.core.tablet_not_now: This tablet only fits the upgrade to level %s.
message.incursion.core.tablet_confirm: The tablet trembles in your hand. Whoever gives it to the Core wakes what waits in the dark … Right-click again within 5 seconds to set it in.
message.incursion.general.upgrade_comple: The %1$s completes the upgrade. The Core awakens to level %2$s.
message.incursion.general.insignia_to_sm: The insignia does not go into the Core. Bring it to a Master Toolsmith together with your Upgrade Tool.
message.incursion.dialog.rune.1: A new face … You look like you are searching for more than books.
message.incursion.dialog.rune.2: Some pages on my shelf I read to no one. Not yet.
message.incursion.dialog.rune.wait: Stay a while. Whoever trades with me often, I might tell more.
message.incursion.dialog.rune.trusted: You have been here often enough. Perhaps I have something for you.
message.incursion.dialog.glow.1: Careful, the brewing stand is hot. Not every flame beneath it is ordinary.
message.incursion.dialog.glow.2: I was entrusted with a recipe I have never brewed.
message.incursion.dialog.glow.wait: Perhaps one day, for someone I trust.
message.incursion.dialog.glow.trusted: For you I might dare it.
message.incursion.dialog.smith.1: This hammer is older than the village. It has forged things you would not believe.
message.incursion.dialog.smith.2: Some metal only joins with the right counterpart.
message.incursion.dialog.smith.wait: Work with me a while, then I will show you what I mean.
message.incursion.dialog.smith.trusted: If you ever find something strange, bring it to me.
message.incursion.villager.down: He is unconscious … He will come to in the morning.
gui.incursion.story_trade.title: Commission
message.incursion.villager.inventory_ful: Your inventory is full. He keeps the rest for you.
message.incursion.working.rune.1: Forgive me, the script demands quiet. I am not done yet.
message.incursion.working.rune.2: The glyphs are headstrong. Give me one more moment.
message.incursion.working.rune.3: Do not disturb me – one false stroke and it was all for nothing.
message.incursion.working.rune.4: Still writing. Patience is the first virtue of an archivist.
message.incursion.ready.rune.1: It is done. Here is %s. Guard it well – some knowledge weighs heavier than lead.
message.incursion.ready.rune.2: The ink has dried. %s is yours. May the old signs guide you.
message.incursion.ready.rune.3: You had trust, I had time. Take %s and bring it where it is needed.
message.incursion.ready.rune.4: The book is closed, the work done. Here: %s. I hope you know what you are carrying.
message.incursion.ready.rune.5: An archivist forgets nothing – and this he will never forget. Take %s.
message.incursion.working.glow.1: It still has to steep, or it will come to nothing.
message.incursion.working.glow.2: The embers need time. Whoever rushes them gets burned.
message.incursion.working.glow.3: Soon! The brew is still boiling – and it already smells dangerously good.
message.incursion.working.glow.4: Do not stir it yet, do not touch it. It is coming along.
message.incursion.ready.glow.1: Done! It has bubbled long enough. Take %s – and keep away from fire.
message.incursion.ready.glow.2: Hot, hot, hot! But it worked. %s is waiting for you.
message.incursion.ready.glow.3: All brewed, nothing spilled. Well, almost nothing. Here: %s.
message.incursion.ready.glow.4: The embers have spoken, and they are pleased. Take %s and use it wisely.
message.incursion.ready.glow.5: I will only say: do not look back when you throw it. %s is yours.
message.incursion.working.smith.1: The metal is not willing yet. Blow by blow.
message.incursion.working.smith.3: It is still glowing. Come back later.
message.incursion.working.smith.4: I am working on it. You will get it when it is done – not before.
message.incursion.ready.smith.1: The metal has cooled, the seal holds. %s is finished, hard won.
message.incursion.ready.smith.2: Well forged, if I may say so myself. Here: %s.
message.incursion.ready.smith.3: The hammer rests. %s is yours – handle it with care.
message.incursion.ready.smith.4: No shoddy work, no frills, just steel and will. Take %s.
message.incursion.ready.smith.5: The best piece I have made in years. %s – wear it with pride.
message.incursion.talk.rune.1.1: Ah, you again. Pick a book, take your time.
message.incursion.talk.rune.1.2: Most only come for the books. You too?
message.incursion.talk.rune.1.3: I am sorting old pages. Some of them are … very old.
message.incursion.talk.rune.2.1: You come by more often. I like that.
message.incursion.talk.rune.2.2: Some books here have not been opened for generations.
message.incursion.talk.rune.2.3: Whoever reads a lot also sees what stands between the lines.
message.incursion.talk.rune.3.1: My teacher left me more than just this shelf.
message.incursion.talk.rune.3.2: Do you sometimes feel watched at night too?
message.incursion.talk.rune.3.3: I have not told anyone about my notes for a long time.
message.incursion.talk.rune.4.1: I think I can show you something soon. Soon.
message.incursion.talk.rune.4.2: There is knowledge that protects and knowledge that is dangerous. Mine is both.
message.incursion.talk.rune.4.3: You are patient. That is rare.
message.incursion.talk.rune.5.1: You have my trust. Ask me about the rune when you are ready.
message.incursion.talk.rune.5.2: What I keep was meant for someone like you.
message.incursion.talk.rune.5.3: The rune is no toy. But I think you know that.
message.incursion.talk.rune.sold.1: I gave you what I had. Take good care of it.
message.incursion.talk.rune.sold.2: Since the rune is gone I sleep more calmly … and worse.
message.incursion.talk.glow.1.1: Careful, the flame under the brewing stand is moody.
message.incursion.talk.glow.1.2: Potions, remedies, prayers. What will it be?
message.incursion.talk.glow.1.3: Do you smell that? Blaze powder. An honest smell.
message.incursion.talk.glow.2.1: You are back. The flame likes you, I think.
message.incursion.talk.glow.2.2: Some potions you only understand after years.
message.incursion.talk.glow.2.3: Today I saw something strange in the smoke.
message.incursion.talk.glow.3.1: The recipe I spoke of … I have read it again.
message.incursion.talk.glow.3.2: Some flames do not burn outwards, but inwards.
message.incursion.talk.glow.3.3: For some ingredients there is no substitute.
message.incursion.talk.glow.4.1: I think soon I would be ready to dare it.
message.incursion.talk.glow.4.2: The potion wakes something. What exactly, I do not know myself.
message.incursion.talk.glow.4.3: If I brew it, then only for you.
message.incursion.talk.glow.5.1: I trust you. When you need the potion, I will brew it.
message.incursion.talk.glow.5.2: Be careful with it. It burns more than wood.
message.incursion.talk.glow.5.3: A potion for a great undertaking. I hope you know what you are doing.
message.incursion.talk.smith.1.1: A good tool is half the work.
message.incursion.talk.smith.1.2: I can hear by the sound whether an iron is any good.
message.incursion.talk.smith.2.1: This hammer belonged to my grandfather. And to his grandfather.
message.incursion.talk.smith.2.2: Some smiths forge tools. Others forge promises.
message.incursion.talk.smith.2.3: You have a feel for good work.
message.incursion.talk.smith.3.1: There are metals that resist. You have to convince them.
message.incursion.talk.smith.3.2: There are signs on my anvil that I cannot read myself.
message.incursion.talk.smith.3.3: Bring me something special one day. I am curious.
message.incursion.talk.smith.4.1: I am almost ready. A little more practice.
message.incursion.talk.smith.4.2: Some things only join under the right blow.
message.incursion.talk.smith.4.3: If you ever find something that does not seem to be of this world … show it to me.
message.incursion.talk.smith.5.1: Bring me your tool and your find, then I will forge them together.
message.incursion.talk.smith.5.2: I am ready. Bring me what you have found.
message.incursion.talk.smith.5.3: My hammer waits for a task worthy of it.
message.incursion.villager.not_yours: That is waiting for someone else.
